# Sample FAQ

## How often should I change engine oil?

For most gasoline-engine cars manufactured after 2010, change the engine oil
every 10,000 km or every 6 months, whichever comes first. Under severe
conditions, use the 5,000 km interval.

## What are signs of a failing alternator?

Dim headlights at idle, the battery warning light on the dash, and a dead
battery after short stops are typical symptoms.
